minimum_buy.rule: A positive issuer-level material anchor plus sufficiently current or independent corroboration.

stronger_buy.rule: Evidence beyond minimum direction that materially strengthens corroboration, persistence, quality, visibility, or valuation support.

adjacent_tie_break: Use 6.0 only when a material unresolved confirmation leaves both 6.0 and 6.5 reasonably supportable.
missing_domain_rule: Missing one particular domain is not an automatic cap when distinct stronger support is established.
symmetry: The same ordinal meanings apply to BUY and SELL strength.
